name: Kuba Kirihito
source:
Kirihito is also Takaaki's kohai (underclassman). He is somewhat stubborn and not liked by many of the teachers in the school. He practices kendou, and if he sees something he thinks is wrong, he is likely to do something about it in a rather violent and forceful manner.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/xasy/xasy.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
